argv: import subprocess,json,shutil; ref='pgvector/pgvector@sha256:cf134a767f474095eeba57e0117be8e568e011a63f33fbf252f14c9b760f8e6f'; p=subprocess.run([shutil.which('docker'),'image','inspect',ref],capture_output=True,timeout=25); error=p.stderr.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').lower(); flags={k:k in error for k in ['no such image','error during connect','access is denied','cannot find the file','docker desktop','daemon','context','permission denied']}; print(json.dumps({'read_only':True,'for_completed_root':1,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stderr_bytes':len(p.stderr),'error_categories':flags,'image':[{'Id':x['Id'],'RepoDigests':x.get('RepoDigests',[])} for x in json.loads(p.stdout)] if p.returncode==0 else None})); raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
